assets.applicability: Markdown documents with structural conventions supported by existing plugins.
assets.contribution: Remark plugins can deterministically inspect supported heading, list, link, and code-fence structures.
assets.evidence_basis: This catalogs the plugin capability family; a later stage must identify and verify a concrete plugin.
limitations: Plugin availability and exact behavior must be established before claiming coverage.
Semantic writing quality is not guaranteed by structural validation.
assets.name: Existing Remark plugins

assets.applicability: Repository-specific Markdown structure that is parseable but unsupported by reusable rules.
assets.contribution: A repository-owned validator can extend deterministic coverage for project-specific Markdown conventions.
assets.evidence_basis: This is an extension path, not a claim that a validator has been implemented or verified.
limitations: Creation is justified only after reusable plugins and configuration are shown insufficient.
Maintenance cost and false positives require verification.
assets.name: Repository Markdown validator
